title: Female dogs.
bodyText: It shall be unlawful for the owner of any female dog, licensed or unlicensed, to permit it to run at large while the dog is in the copulating season.
bodyHtml: §143-14  Female dogs.  It shall be unlawful for the owner of any female dog, licensed or unlicensed, to permit it to run at large while the dog is in the copulating season. [L 1941, c 268, §12; RL 1945, §7163; RL 1955, §156-14; HRS §143-14]
